content:
From the first three terms:
\[
a^3r^3=3
\]
From the last three terms:
\[
a^3r^{3n-6}=9
\]
Dividing gives:
\[
r^{3n-9}=3
\]

The product of all terms is:
\[
a^n r^{n(n-1)/2}=729
\]
Using \(a=3^{1/3}/r\):
\[
3^{n/3}r^{n(n-3)/2}=729
\]
Now rewrite:
\[
r^{n(n-3)/2}=(r^{3n-9})^{n/6}=3^{n/6}
\]
So:
\[
3^{n/3}\cdot 3^{n/6}=3^{n/2}=729=3^6
\]
Thus:
\[
n/2=6 \implies n=12
\]

\[
\boxed{12}
\]
